decisions.title: Updated Rail Yards Master Plan
decisions.description: Updates the adopted Rail Yards redevelopment framework, development regulations, design guidance, transportation recommendations, site concepts, phasing, and supporting appendices for Albuquerque’s historic rail-industrial complex.
decisions.provenance_status: official City Council project page and City Planning PDF recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative PDF will be preserved without modification.
User explicitly approved production R2 upload on 2026-08-21 despite the project threshold for files over 100 MB.
decisions.large_file_assessment: The 227,660,262-byte (217.11 MiB) PDF is unusually large because it is a graphics-intensive master plan containing detailed photographs, maps, drawings, and plan sheets. No smaller authoritative consolidated 2023 version was identified. Optimization would alter the authoritative source and was not performed.
